mini.passage: Ovaries contain egg cells; testes produce sperm cells after puberty begins. A pregnancy can begin when a sperm fertilizes an egg, usually in a fallopian tube, and the resulting developing structure implants in the uterus. Grade 7 extension: sexually transmitted infections can spread through sexual contact, sometimes without symptoms. Avoiding sexual contact prevents sexual transmission; correctly used condoms reduce but do not eliminate infection risk. Other birth-control methods do not protect against STIs. A trusted adult or health professional can answer questions.

items.answer: The uterus supports an implanted pregnancy; a sperm cell and egg cell can combine in fertilization.
